uncertainty_represented: Dependence of the seasonal-cycle PH result on a single observed calendar year. Days are NOT resampled independently (strong autocorrelation + embedding windows span 210-630 days); no block bootstrap concatenation is used (it would create artificial delay windows at block boundaries).
status_guard: SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS on six years of single-station data: not a population-level climate claim, not a formal confidence interval, not a hypothesis test. No parameter is retuned after inspecting folds.
interpretation_guard: A dominant H1 class evidences recurrent quasi-periodic structure of the embedded series at the studied scale; it is NOT proof of a simple closed physical climate trajectory (same wording rule as the meteorology extension).
